title: Pharmacist can clear Pharmacy discharge but cannot read its current stage or reconcile a lost answer
actual: demo.pharmacist has ipd.discharge.clear_pharmacy and prescription.view, but lacks ipd.admission.view. On NEW own labelled synthetic admission1, GET /admissions/1 and GET /admissions/1/discharge-status both403 FORBIDDEN. GET /admissions/1/own-medicines200. Dispense bundle requires PharmacyClearance and clear endpoint state-guard lost-answer rule explicitly says GET /admissions/{id} reconciliation. No permission-scoped discharge read route is documented for pharmacist, so UI cannot safely verify next stage/patient or reconcile clearance without granting broader admission access.
expected: Provide a minimum-necessary pharmacist discharge read/status route (identity, next stage, clearance result) allowed by ipd.discharge.clear_pharmacy, or extend the intended existing read authorization and contract. Its response must support PharmacyClearance prerequisite check and lost-answer read reconciliation. We keep clearance disabled with an explanation until current stage can be verified; no guessed success/replayed clearance.
steps: 1. As demo.doctor create labelled synthetic admission on own test patient (actual admission1). 2. As demo.pharmacist GET /auth/me -> ipd.discharge.clear_pharmacy present, ipd.admission.view absent. 3. GET /admissions/1 ->403; GET /admissions/1/discharge-status ->403; GET /admissions/1/own-medicines ->200. 4. Read dispense rule83ef3c740f and clear endpoint write_semantics.reconcile_with.
